title: Policy
description: One access control policy. This is the document the Policy Builder edits, the engine evaluates, and policy-as-code export writes to YAML (FR-9.3). It is deliberately the only definition of these fields anywhere in the system: Java and TypeScript are both generated from it.

scopeLevel.description: Where the policy sits in the hierarchy. Layers compose by intersection from ORG downwards; they never replace each other (FR-3.1.3). DOMAIN policies nest further by sub-domain depth.

exemption.description: Takes a named principal out of this policy. The expiry is mandatory by design: an exemption with no end date is how a temporary carve-out becomes permanent without anyone deciding it should (FR-3.5).

policyType.description: SUBSCRIPTION answers who may reach the table at all; DATA answers what they see inside it. Immuta splits these for a reason: they are authored by different people at different times.

scopeFqn.description: The anchor of the scope, for example the domain FQN for a DOMAIN policy. Empty for ORG.

selector.description: Which assets this policy binds to, resolved into policy_binding and re-resolved whenever facets change, so an asset tagged tomorrow is covered tomorrow without anyone pressing a button (FR-3.1.6).

effect.description: DENY always beats ALLOW, and no match at all is a deny. Fail-closed is not configurable.

data.description: Row filters and column rules. Present when policyType is DATA.

allowLocalOverride.description: Whether a lower layer may relax this policy. Default false: local policies add strictness only. Turning it on is an explicit, audited decision by the author of the higher layer (FR-3.1.4).

requiresApproval.description: Present from Phase 1 so the Phase 2 request workflow needs no migration. In Phase 1 an owner grants directly and this field only records intent (FR-3.4).
